blocks.text: MIAMI— Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 27 points and nearly got a triple-double in his first game against his former franchise, Bam Adebayo had 21 of his 26 points in the first half and the sizzling Miami Heat downed the sliding Milwaukee Bucks 137-130 on Wednesday night. Antetokounmpo added 14 rebounds and nine assists for Miami, which won its sixth straight and has gone 9-2 since starting 0-4. Davion Mitchell scored 24 for the Heat, who made 22 3-pointers.
